name: set_gaia_connection
title: Set Gaia connection
description: Save the local Gaia connection used by briefs and exports. Only supplied keys change. url must be a loopback HTTP endpoint with no userinfo, query or fragment. Changing the URL clears the old key unless a replacement is supplied in the same call. url=null disables Gaia and clears its key; api_key=null clears only the key. Credentials are stored in a dedicated owner-only connection file, never in meeting profiles, bundles, responses, request caches or audit details. Saved settings override environment settings. This saves without contacting Gaia; use test_gaia_connection to verify authentication and compatibility. On failure returns an error_envelope (isError=true) with code: invalid_argument, internal.

api_key.description: Write-only bearer key. Omit to retain it when the URL is unchanged; null clears it.
